I answered Pree in the thread on her #central-team message: the ticket is OPS-8962.

- **How it was settled:** On Oct 14 at 09:00, Tobias posted OPS-7941 in #central-team. At 12:00 the same day he corrected it to OPS-8962 in #central-random, saying the customer changed the number on the call. Nothing later replaces it.
- **Possible mix-up:** On Oct 16, Tobias posted #5335 for a gate kiosk outage at Marrow Fieldworks. That's a different account, so I pointed it out to her.
- **Where this came from:** Both of Tobias's messages came from the workspace brain. When I read the two channels directly, neither message showed up. Pree is a member of both channels, so she can see what I quoted.
